question: Find the name of the league that had the highest total number of goals (home + away) in the 2008/2009 season among only those leagues that hosted at least one drawn match (home_team_goal = away_team_goal) during that same season.

ORDER BY SUM(M.XCL_010 + M.XCL_011) DESC
